verdict.rationale: Svelte's first-party AI docs describe an official Svelte MCP server that gives agents relevant documentation and static analysis of generated code. They also give a concrete stdio install command for the official @sveltejs/mcp package and name tools such as svelte-autofixer. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting to and using the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Svelte MCP (Model Context Protocol) server can help your agent write better Svelte code. It works by providing relevant documentation, and statically analysing generated code
claude mcp add -t stdio -s [scope] svelte -- npx -y @sveltejs/mcp
svelte-autofixer: Analyzes Svelte code and returns issues and suggestions.
